Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 28 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Suresh - 31 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vikram stands in the living room. Suresh stands near him.]

Suresh: "What lovely weather!"

[Vikram pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Suresh: "One more time!"

[Vikram walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Vikram: "How beautiful!"

[Vikram jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Vikram (surprised): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
